value.rationale: Codimension-two singular-fiber counts are the established currency of stable-map complexity. Kato's new theorem gives arbitrary prescribed indefinite fold loci but only a qualitative existence statement. The formula quantifies the new construction exactly from braid data, produces a sharp \(0/1/\ge4\) gap at the low-complexity end, and gives a word-independent parity constraint once strand number and component count are fixed. This is a natural structural refinement rather than an arbitrary finite slice or a parameter substitution.
